description: Customer service and shared inbox platform powered by AI for managing team and agent communications.
auth_notes: Uses OAuth2 authorization code flow for public apps and API tokens/bearer tokens for private apps.
credential_notes: Developers can sign up for a free developer account providing a free sandbox environment with limited teammates.
api_notes: Extensive Core API, webhooks, plugin SDK, and native MCP support covering contacts, conversations, messages, and comments.
mcp_notes: Front provides official MCP servers (including standard and admin MCP servers) for AI agents.
rationale: Front provides a comprehensive public REST API, official MCP servers, and free self-serve developer accounts.

evidence.note: Describes authentication options for public and private apps.
Details signing up for a free developer account and free developer environment.
Lists Core API, MCP server, Plugin SDK, and Channels API capabilities.
Explicitly documents official MCP Server and Admin MCP Server support.
